journeys.title: First-time visitor: landing -> quiz -> results -> pricing
journeys.stop: never reaches a checkout; card fields are never touched
steps: open / and read the hero, proof points and primary CTA
start /quiz; answer every step, including back/forward
reach /quiz/review and /results with and without state
read the teaser / gated state on /results
follow the CTA to /pricing; read every tier, price and button label
follow the footer links (terms, privacy, support)

journeys.title: Sign-up and log-in surfaces (render + validation only)
journeys.stop: no account is created; no credential is typed
steps: /login renders the form, the Turnstile widget and the forgot-password link
submit empty and malformed values: client-side validation and messages
/forgot-password form validation
/signup renders; terms links resolve
/reset-password?code=qa-invalid and /verify show an actionable state

journeys.title: Paid customer: case profile -> every Apply section -> checklist
journeys.stop: writes are blocked by the harness
steps: log in as B via the helper; land on /case-profile
follow each Apply link (overview, module1-4, module3 a-l, business, investment, family, qualifications, story, ties, calendar, checklist, upload)
check progress indicators, next-step CTAs and back links
as D: /apply* bounces to /terms-required?next=<path>

journeys.title: Document upload -> extraction -> review -> gaps (read-only)
steps: /apply/upload lists the existing files
/apply/upload/processing, /review and /gaps render for a persona with data
delete/replace controls are present but never confirmed

journeys.title: Generation and download UI (read-only)
journeys.stop: no generation is started (POSTs blocked, LLM disabled)
steps: /generate/{C.app} shows package status
/documents/{C.app} lists documents with download links
the owner download route answers (OP1)
B and C cannot open each other's /documents and /generate pages

journeys.title: Interview simulator
journeys.stop: no session is started; LLM disabled
steps: /simulator hub, /quick-start, /case-file, /interview-day, /outcome, /prep-kit render
LLM-dependent panels show a clear error / empty state, not a blank page

journeys.title: Gap analysis, market analysis and FDD
steps: /gap-analysis and /market-analysis render for B
/fdd, /fdd/compare, /fdd/upload render for B (empty) and A (data, read-only)
FDD report/score/territory/questions/review for A

journeys.title: Franchise discovery and renewal
journeys.stop: no message or intake is submitted
steps: /franchise, /discover, /matches, /connect, /brand/assisting-hands
/renewal entry and its intake / documents pages for a user without a renewal purchase

journeys.title: Settings, consent, terms and account lifecycle
journeys.stop: delete / export / sign-out controls are never clicked
steps: /settings sections render and toggles are reachable
D: /terms-required flow
/retention/confirm-hold?token=qa-invalid and /unsubscribe?token=qa-invalid show a clear invalid-link state
/account-recovery as anonymous

journeys.title: Trust surfaces
journeys.stop: the support form is never submitted
steps: /support form validation
/terms, /privacy, /about, /learn hub and six articles, /early-access, /partner-access

journeys.title: Brand-host gate (Host: e2go.app)
journeys.stop: HTTP only; /api/early-access gets validation probes only
steps: allowed: /, /early-access, /api/early-access (400 on invalid), /api/_sentry-tunnel
everything else redirects to /early-access, including /login, /pricing and /api/*

journeys.title: Admin surface (deny side only)
journeys.stop: no admin session exists; admin-positive paths are a documented gap (G1)
steps: anonymous -> /login?next=/admin...
role=user (B, C) -> redirected to / or 404 for every /admin page, including the [userId] pages with another persona's id
no admin data is rendered to a non-admin

staticChecks: next build (scratch copy; never in the repo while a dev server shares .next)
exit 0; 194 static pages; warnings not above the 359 / 10 / 1 baseline
python3 scripts/audit-schema-drift.py --refresh (env sourced; check it does not rewrite tracked files)
grep user-facing strings for E2Go / E2GO / e2GO / bare e2go
no violations outside the documented exceptions
inventory: unresolved literal paths + orphan API routes
no more than the recorded 11 unresolved / 22 orphan
grep the tracked tree and .next/static for key material (sk_live, service_role, private keys)
L2-5 response headers on /, /login, /api/health (HSTS is set in next.config.mjs:64)
HSTS, nosniff, frame protection, referrer policy, permissions policy present
title, description, canonical, OG per public page; robots + sitemap
unique titles/descriptions; robots + sitemap exist (known absent)
each /api/cron/* handler checks CRON_SECRET before any effect
source review of src/app/actions/*.ts (SA1-SA3) plus the L0 self-test that a Server Action POST is blocked by the harness
each action authorizes the caller and proves ownership of any e-mail it acts on

knownGaps.title: No admin persona
knownGaps.impact: admin-positive paths (all /admin/*, /api/admin/*) are untestable; only the deny side is tested
knownGaps.mitigation: create a dedicated QA admin in a staging project

knownGaps.title: No unpaid / sim-only / FDD-only / soft-deleted / unverified persona
knownGaps.impact: paid-gate fall-through (/results, /simulator), FDD-only pass, /account-recovery for a real deleted user and e-mail-verification states are untested

knownGaps.title: application_documents is empty in the shared database
knownGaps.impact: /api/documents/[id] and /download, and the extraction / gap-report paths that read it, cannot be tested with real data; NIL-id cells only
knownGaps.mitigation: seed rows in a staging project, or upload a fixture as persona B

knownGaps.title: FDD pages are testable only through the real founder account (A)
knownGaps.impact: A is read-only and needs --allow-A; B/C/D have no FDD analyses
knownGaps.mitigation: seed FDD analyses for a QA persona

knownGaps.title: Single browser engine (embedded Chromium)
knownGaps.impact: Safari/WebKit and Firefox rendering, real-device touch and OS font rendering are untested
knownGaps.mitigation: run the same queues on BrowserStack / real devices

knownGaps.title: Supabase project is shared with production
knownGaps.impact: every authenticated E1 action lands in the production database; 429s are written to rate_limit_hits
knownGaps.mitigation: a staging Supabase project or branch

knownGaps.title: Session lifecycle is untested
knownGaps.impact: expired-token refresh, concurrent sessions, sign-out from the UI (never clicked) and cookie chunk rollover
knownGaps.mitigation: a dedicated lifecycle test with a disposable account

knownGaps.title: Stripe checkout / payment / webhook paths are not exercised
knownGaps.impact: pricing -> checkout -> success -> entitlement is verified by inspection only (UAT-03 was verified live by the owner)

knownGaps.title: There is no HTTP logout route
knownGaps.impact: sign-out is client-side auth.signOut; an HTTP logout test is impossible (the v1.0 L3-7 cell is dropped)

knownGaps.title: E-mail content and deliverability
knownGaps.impact: RESEND_API_KEY is disabled in the QA instance; templates are reviewed statically only
knownGaps.mitigation: send to a seed inbox in staging

knownGaps.title: LLM-backed features run with LLM keys disabled
knownGaps.impact: generation, simulator scoring, FDD extraction, gap analysis and market analysis are exercised only through their error / empty states
knownGaps.mitigation: a funded run with --allow-llm against a staging database
